name: TIP (Paclitaxel / Ifosfamide / CISplatin)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - conventional-dose salvage

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Conventional-dose taxane-based salvage combination for platinum-sensitive relapsed germ cell tumor after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Serum tumor markers track response. Dose and schedule in our own words for a DRAFT decision-support tool.

histology: germ cell tumor (seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT), platinum-sensitive relapse

premedications.name: Taxane hypersensitivity prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Paclitaxel premedication (corticosteroid + H1/H2 blockade) before each infusion.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk)
premedications.notes: CISplatin-containing multi-day regimen; give guideline-based multi-agent prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: Mesna uroprotection with ifosfamide (matched to the ifosfamide dose, given before and after each ifosfamide dose) to prevent haemorrhagic cystitis.
Vigorous hydration with CISplatin; monitor renal function and electrolytes (magnesium, potassium).
G-CSF support is generally required with TIP given myelosuppression.
Monitor for ifosfamide neurotoxicity (encephalopathy) and paclitaxel peripheral neuropathy.
monitoring: Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) before each cycle and at restaging
Renal function and electrolytes before/through each cycle - CISplatin and ifosfamide
Audiometry and neurologic assessment - platinum ototoxicity, taxane/ifosfamide neurotoxicity

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ifosfamide and review; consider methylene blue and supportive care. Physician decides.
Review required; delay or reduce per institutional criteria and ensure G-CSF support. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: Paclitaxel 250 mg/m2 IV as a 24-hour continuous infusion on Day 1, every 21 days. Requires taxane hypersensitivity premedication. Dose and schedule in our own words from standard conventional-dose salvage practice (general references NCCN/DeVita).

drugs.name: Ifosfamide
drugs.notes: Ifosfamide 1500 mg/m2 IV on Days 2 to 5, every 21 days, with mesna uroprotection. Dose and schedule in our own words from standard conventional-dose salvage practice (general references NCCN/DeVita).

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 25 mg/m2 IV on Days 2 to 5 (total 100 mg/m2 per cycle), every 21 days, with vigorous hydration. Tall-man per ISMP. Dose and schedule in our own words from standard conventional-dose salvage practice (general references NCCN/DeVita).
